#### Testing whether four independent vectors fit in a three-dimensional subspace

@thm-dim-bound caps how many [linearly independent vectors](#def-linearly-independent) a [subspace](#def-subspace) can hold.
Let $\mathcal{S}$ be a subspace of $\reals^5$ with [dimension](#def-dimension) $3$.

Can $\mathcal{S}$ contain $4$ linearly independent vectors?
